description: This file contains ASN.1 decoding functions for the BoringSSL cryptography library, including ASN.1 tag parsing, primitive and complex type decoding, and handling of ASN.1 sequences, sets, choices, and string types.

methods.name: ASN1_item_d2i
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 data into a structure based on ASN1_ITEM, handling various ASN.1 types and tagging.

methods.name: asn1_item_ex_d2i
methods.description: Internal function that performs detailed ASN.1 decoding with support for tagging, optional fields, and recursion depth control.

methods.name: asn1_template_ex_d2i
methods.description: Handles decoding of ASN.1 templates, including explicit tagging and optional fields.

methods.name: asn1_template_noexp_d2i
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 templates without explicit tagging, supporting SET OF, SEQUENCE OF, and primitive types.

methods.name: asn1_ex_c2i
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 content octets into corresponding C structures based on type.

methods.name: asn1_d2i_ex_primitive
methods.description: Decodes primitive ASN.1 types, handling various ASN.1 string and primitive types.

methods.name: asn1_check_tlen
methods.description: Checks ASN.1 tag and length, similar to ASN1_get_object, with expected tag and class validation.
